summary: Responsive validation of /syndicat-admin/citadelle/annonces (AdminCitadelleListings.js). Login admin OK. Tested viewports 375x812, 400x850 (mobile) and 1920x800 (desktop). Verified all tabs (pending, active, all, rejected), row stacking, and detail modal (Voir). NO destructive actions performed (no delete/validate/reject/payment/email trigger). Result: NO horizontal overflow at any tested viewport; rows correctly stack (flexDir=column) on mobile and align in row on desktop; detail modal fits within viewport with Quality panel and Social consent panel visible.
notes: Tab 'sold' (Vendues) requested in the problem statement DOES NOT EXIST in TABS array at AdminCitadelleListings.js line 140-145. Actual tabs are: pending, active, all, rejected. Sold listings appear inside the 'all' tab (status badge 'Vendue'). This is a discrepancy in the request text, not a bug — status label 'sold' exists in STATUS_LABELS (line 17) but not as a filter tab. Please confirm with product whether a 'Vendues' filter tab should be added.

In the 'all' tab, the first row displayed on 400px viewport reports offsetWidth=496 while viewport is 400. However document.body.scrollWidth stays at 400 because parent container clips/scrolls internally without leaking to body. No visible horizontal overflow was observed in screenshots. This is acceptable but worth checking that inner content isn't clipped (visual review of the 400px screenshot shows action buttons on right side of row potentially cropped by ~90px on some very-wide rows). Recommend main agent verify that action buttons remain fully visible in the 'all' tab at 400px width.
